selection_principle.rule: Include the complete isotropic-photon subsection of summary Table S3, with one row for each listed operator dimension d=3 through d=9.
selection_principle.reason: This is a pre-registered propagation-symmetry slice chosen before any microscopic candidate is admitted; it is not selected by a fit or by a candidate score.
selection_principle.deferred_scope: Matter, anisotropic photon, neutrino, gravity, and data-table rows are deferred to separately versioned packets and are not silently treated as absent evidence.

scope.table_semantics: Maximal two-sided sensitivities; conservative 2-sigma order-of-magnitude summaries with one coefficient nonzero.
scope.unit_convention: Natural units hbar=c=epsilon_0=k_B=1; mass units in GeV.
scope.use: Independent feasibility checks only; no aggregate score or likelihood.

uncertainty_contract.row_rule: Evaluate each row separately as a feasibility bound; retain the source one-coefficient convention and quoted order-of-magnitude semantics.
forbidden: Do not multiply rows into a joint likelihood.
Do not interpret the seven operator dimensions as independent experiments.
Do not convert a summary sensitivity into a Gaussian standard deviation.
Do not add a candidate-dependent row or remove a row after seeing predictions.

theory_map_contract.current_use: No microscopic candidate is admitted; this file only fixes the source rows and their feasibility semantics.

acceptance.pass: All seven row identifiers, source locators, dimensions, quoted sensitivities, and independent-row rules remain unchanged and the source packet hash matches.
acceptance.falsifier: Any source hash drift, ambiguous row identity, silent unit/frame change, or attempt to aggregate rows without a supplied source likelihood invalidates this packet and requires a new version.

evidence_level: T0 source-lineage plus pre-registered finite feasibility interface
assumptions: The source packet hash identifies the exact January 2026 arXiv v19 bytes.
The S3 isotropic subsection is read in the source Sun-centered frame and natural-unit convention.
The displayed sensitivities are conservative two-sigma order-of-magnitude bounds under the source one-coefficient convention.
A feasibility intersection may be represented row by row without inventing a joint distribution.
missing_assumptions: Measurement-level likelihoods and covariance for any quantitative score.
A candidate-owned map through all four forward stages.
A fixed theory-error and nuisance budget.
Independent holdout data for empirical validation.
non_claims: This allowlist does not prove exact Lorentz invariance, a causal cone, or a dispersion theorem.
It does not identify or select TECT microstructure, dynamics, a vacuum, or a physical sector.
It does not establish Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, A13, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, continuum, empirical predictivity, a mass gap, or a theory of everything.
It does not make the seven rows independent observations or a joint likelihood.
next_action: Run the existing schema/lineage checks against this frozen row set; keep candidate scoring stopped until source uncertainty and all F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs stages are admitted.
